# `exists`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
exists(expr, pred)
```

Tests whether a predicate holds for one or more elements in the array.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- exists, example 1
> SELECT exists(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x % 2 == 0);
true
```

```sql
-- exists, example 2
> SELECT exists(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x % 2 == 10);
false
```

```sql
-- exists, example 3
> SELECT exists(array(1, null, 3), x -> x % 2 == 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- exists, example 4
> SELECT exists(array(0, null, 2, 3, null), x -> x IS NULL);
true
```

```sql
-- exists, example 5
> SELECT exists(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x IS NULL);
false
```
